{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Extends the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp with prune lock and target pruning functions.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Exposes prune lock management and target-based pruning needed for asynchronous block reading by external library consumers. As noted in commit 37e40a00e9, applications reading blocks after connection require locks to prevent the node from deleting them before processing completes."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches validation only for block storage flushing logic; does not alter mempool acceptance, policy, or eviction.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not touch transaction relay or mempool policy."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test modifications in src/test/kernel/ and src/test/chainstate_write_tests.cpp test the new pruning and kernel APIs rather than general test infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Area-specific tests belong to kernel and validation, not test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications to src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp are minimal glue updates following the kernel refactor.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Minor adjustments to example binaries do not make this a tools PR."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/init.cpp and context files are routine wiring for block manager initialization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Wiring changes at startup do not constitute shared utility infrastructure changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Validation label and alters block storage pruning and flush mechanics across src/node/blockstorage.cpp and src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Decouples block storage pruning and file deletion from FlushStateToDisk into BlockManager, fixing a minor issue where failed flushes orphaned prune files until restart. Because this substantively changes block storage flush flow alongside kernel API additions, it may need to be split for dedicated validation review."
    }
